title: Cancer Detection Centre
description: Founded by the Nellore Red Cross Team under Dr. A.V. Subramanyam, on government-allotted land, inaugurated by Governor Dr. C. Rangarajan.

title: Surgical Department Established
description: Dr. Aruna Chandra Sekharan set up the Surgical Oncology department — OT, wards and pathology lab — funded by philanthropic donations.

title: Radiotherapy Begins
description: The Radiation Department, funded by the Dodla Vardha Reddy & Rukminamma Charitable Trust, was inaugurated by President Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.

title: New Surgical Block
description: Twin theatres, a 12-bed ICU and surgical OPDs, funded by the Bhagawan Mahavir Jain Charitable Trust, inaugurated by Sri Mohanlal Jain.

title: Medical Oncology Department
description: A dedicated Medical Oncology department opened, extending care to nearly all cancer types.

title: New RT Block & Lab
description: A new Radiotherapy block and Pathology & Biochemistry lab, inaugurated by Governor Sri Biswa Bhusan Harichandan.

title: LINAC & CT in Partnership with ICON Group
description: Advanced Linear Accelerator radiotherapy and CT imaging installed for modern, precise treatment.

title: Integrated Cancer Care
description: Surgical, Medical and Radiation Oncology, diagnostics, nursing and patient-support services under one roof, serving four districts.
